title: Erdős Problem #1179: Uniform Subset Sum Representations in Abelian Groups
description: Question: Estimate g_ε(N). In particular, is g_ε(N) = (1 + o_ε(1)) log₂ N?

overview.historicalContext:
Erdős Problem #1179 concerns uniform subset sum representations in abelian groups. This problem has been PROVED.

Known results include: - Trivial lower bound: g_ε(N) ≥ log₂ N (need 2^k ≥ N representations) - Erdős-Rényi (1965): g_ε(N) ≤ (2 + o(1)) log₂ N + O_ε(1) - Erdős-Hall (1976): g_ε(N) ≤ (1 + O_ε(log log log N / log log N)) log₂ N - [ErRe65] Erdős, Rényi: Probabilistic Methods in Group Theory (1965)

This problem is catalogued at erdosproblems.com/1179.
